acceptance: All six slots require independent trace/response/artifact review and acceptance (6/6) before the original 18/18 gate may be attempted. Automated evidence alone does not accept a run. Missing outcome/evidence and startup failures fail; no pooling, substitution, retries or new models.
failure_policy: Preflight failure blocks all six declared slots. Runner startup failure or missing outcome/evidence is retained in its slot; continue sequentially without replacement. Source, criteria or runner drift blocks remaining slots. No unrelated process is killed. A failed pilot keeps the original 18-run gate blocked and triggers diagnosis, then a separately declared fresh batch under the persistence contract; it does not end the overall task.
